intended_object: An internal proof step: the equivariant vertex-value "assignment" on the library's one-step collar cell system, built from a compatible chart map. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the surrounding code.
explanation: This definition only packages data. It applies the library's `assignmentOfEquivariantVector` to `globalVector hp K`, which is the decorated chart-map value pushed down to the quotient of cover vertex slots, together with the equivariance proof `globalVector_smul`. The result is a value of type `Assignment hp (Cells hp N)`, a type the library defines for its own construction of the one-step endpoint stack (part of a Fox–Neuwirth / Nandakumar–Ramana Rao proof). It is a step in a proof, not a standard notion from the literature, so no textbook definition or Mathlib counterpart exists to compare it with.
